# Beak

> A configuration-driven admin panel for Dart and Flutter. Declare your models
> once and get a typed REST API, a Flutter panel, migrations and seeds — with
> no hand-written endpoints and no client/server plumbing.

Beak is one dependency. A project is a `pubspec.yaml`, a folder of model
declarations, and optionally a folder of screens. Everything else — the panel,
the router, the API, the entrypoints — is generated by the `beak` CLI and stays
invisible until you run `beak eject` to take it over.

## The shape of a project

```
acme_admin/
  pubspec.yaml          one dependency: beak
  beak.yaml             optional: title, api origin, icons, sections
  lib/models/           DISCOVERED: one @Resource class per file
  lib/screens/          optional: a top-level BeakScreen per file
  lib/migrations/       optional: hand-written, discovered, run in name order
  lib/seeders/          optional
  lib/beak/*.g.dart     GENERATED, committed
  lib/main.dart         GENERATED, git-ignored
  bin/serve.dart        GENERATED, git-ignored
  bin/migrate.dart      GENERATED, git-ignored
```

Nothing is registered by hand. `beak prepare` scans the folders and wires up
what it finds.

## A resource

```dart
import 'package:beak/beak.dart';
import 'package:beak/schema.dart';

part 'product.beak.dart';

@Resource(softDeletes: true, timestamps: true)
final class Product extends BeakSchema {
  /// What the product is called.
  @Display()
  @Column(searchable: true, sortable: true, rules: [BeakMaxLength(120)])
  late final String name;

  /// The long description.
  @Column(searchable: true)
  late final BeakText? description;

  /// Shelf price.
  @Column(sortable: true)
  late final double price;

  /// The hero image.
  @Image()
  late final BeakImageRef? photo;

  /// The category this belongs to.
  @BelongsTo()
  late final Category? category;
}
```

Two rules cover most of the surface:

- **The field's type picks the column.** `String` is single-line text,
  `BeakText` multi-line, `BeakRichText` rich text, `int`/`double`/`bool`/
  `DateTime` the obvious ones, `BeakImageRef`/`BeakFileRef` uploads,
  `BeakHexColor` a colour, `BeakJson` JSON, and any Dart `enum` a choice column.
- **Nullability decides required-ness.** `String name` is required; `int? stock`
  is not. One rule covers the form validator, the API's validation and the
  database's `NOT NULL`.

Relationships are `@BelongsTo`, `@HasOne`, `@HasMany` and
`@BelongsToMany(pivotTable: '...')`. Declaring one side is enough; the
generator writes the inverse.

## The libraries

| Import | Carries |
| --- | --- |
| `package:beak/beak.dart` | Columns, models, query specs. No Flutter, no `dart:io`. |
| `package:beak/panel.dart` | The widgets. Re-exports `beak.dart`. |
| `package:beak/schema.dart` | `@Resource`, `@Column`, `@BelongsTo`, `BeakText`, … |
| `package:beak/server.dart` | The Shelf host, config, storage. |
| `package:beak/migrations.dart` | The schema DSL plus `BeakBlueprint`. |
| `package:beak/testing.dart` | `InMemoryBeakDataSource`, the adapter contract. |
| `package:beak/ui.dart` | obers_ui widgets. |
| `package:beak/charts.dart` | obers_ui charts. |

A model file imports `beak.dart` and `schema.dart`. A screen imports
`panel.dart`. `bin/serve.dart` imports `server.dart`. Importing the server half
from a panel file breaks the web build and the server's ahead-of-time compile;
`beak doctor` fails on it.

## Commands

| Command | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `beak create <name>` | Scaffold a project. |
| `beak prepare` | Regenerate from what the project declares. |
| `beak dev` | Regenerate, serve the API, run the panel. |
| `beak introspect <url>` | Write models for the tables a Postgres database already has. |
| `beak eject <target>` | Write a Beak default out as a file you own. |
| `beak make:migration <Name> --from-model` | A migration derived from the model. |
| `beak migrate` / `beak seed` | Apply migrations; run seeders. |
| `beak doctor` | Diagnose the project. `--json` for CI. |

## The REST surface

Every registered model gets these under `/api/{table}`:

```
POST   /query                                 a BeakQuerySpec -> a page
POST   /aggregate                             count / sum / avg
POST   /batch                                 many records by id
POST   /                                      create
GET    /<id>                                  read
PATCH  /<id>                                  partial update
DELETE /<id>                                  soft delete (?force=true to purge)
POST   /<id>/restore                          undo a soft delete
POST   /<id>/relations/<key>/attach           link
POST   /<id>/relations/<key>/detach           unlink
POST   /export                                CSV
```

Plus `GET /api/search`, the auth routes, and `GET /healthz` / `GET /readyz`
outside `/api`.

A query body needs only `table`; every other key defaults. `PATCH` honours
`If-Unmodified-Since` against `updated_at` and answers `409` when it has moved.

## Conventions that matter

- **No Material.** The panel is obers_ui; `package:flutter/material.dart` is
  banned and a guard fails the build on it.
- **No `dynamic`, no `as` casts, no `Map<String, Object?>` as a domain type.**
  Users never write a string column reference.
- **Migrations are explicit.** Beak never alters a database on its own.
- **Relations are eager.** Declare what you need with `withRelations([...])`;
  reading an unloaded relation throws.
- **Row-level authorization** is `BeakRowPolicy.scopeFor`, enforced in the
  service so every endpoint inherits it.
